releaseNotes: Conditional trip actions now follow trip lifecycle and active membership state.
Expense detail rendering handles offline/dummy members without crashing.
Expenses can be removed from active totals with ledger reversals and retained audit history.
Pending payments can be edited; confirmed, disputed, and cancelled payments remain immutable.
Trip creators can permanently delete a trip and its related data.
Trip dashboard total spent now uses the backend totalSpentPaise contract.
Improved transaction limits and database write batching for remote MySQL reliability.
